title: Nuance Matters: Probing Epistemic Consistency in Causal Reasoning

live_model.evidence: Table 1 row "GPT-4 Turbo 0.397±0.541 0.226±0.459 0.526±0.510 0.849±0.330 0.942±0.151" among 21 closed/open-source LLMs evaluated

prompt.note: Three-phase pipeline: generate 10 intermediates per cause-effect pair, rank them with the same LLM, score against the generation order.

claim.location: Table 1, row GPT-4 Turbo, ω-all column (other columns: ω-A 0.397, ω-D 0.226, CGP 0.849, IGC 0.942)

data.source: ε-CAUSAL dataset (Cui et al. 2024b), 1,970 defeasible cause-effect pairs; code at https://github.com/cui-shaobo/causal-consistency

notes: Self-consistency pipeline: the same LLM generates 10 intermediates per pair then re-ranks them; ground truth is the model's own generation order, so no separate judge model is needed. Reproducing the GPT-4 Turbo row needs about 2 calls/pair (generate+rank) x 1,970 pairs x 3 seeds.
